title: Linux kernel will support $ORIGIN, sort of
summary: This article discusses the Linux kernel's upcoming support for $ORIGIN in dynamic linking, a feature that allows executables to find shared libraries relative to their own location. The 'sort of' in the title suggests a limited or conditional implementation, likely addressing security concerns with setuid/setuid binaries while enabling more flexible library loading.
problem_solved: Enables executables to reliably locate shared libraries relative to their own installation directory, improving portability and reducing dependency on hardcoded paths.
why_valuable: This feature enhances library loading flexibility in Linux while maintaining security boundaries, making it easier to distribute self-contained applications with bundled libraries.
